set.body: Goal: native/viewport coordinates currently flow raw into backends, and SVG's y-down axis silently mirrors plots vertically: a Bottom axis positioned at yScale.lower renders at the visual top of the panel, and SvgRendererSuite pins this as 'raw native viewBox coordinates'. Decide the data-space convention (y-up, grid-style) and represent orientation explicitly in the scene model (viewport or coord carries axis direction) instead of every backend guessing. Acceptance: scene/viewport model carries an explicit y-direction; SVG output renders increasing data-y upward and Bottom axes at the visual bottom; conformance cases pin orientation for every primitive and for compiled plots; graphics and graphics-svg JVM/JS tests updated and passing.
set.title: Graphics: make y-orientation an explicit coordinate policy
